heard: 4 Four kings marched to war that day against the five in the valley. Twelve years they searched Ador-lomer. 5 But in the thirteenth they rebelled. The valley of Sodom had pits, where kings of Sodom fell. The goods of Sodom were seized, and Lot was taken away I raise my hand to God, most high maker of heaven and earth I will accept nothing from you Not a thread or sandal strap so you can never say I made Abram rich 318 minerals born in Abram
